svg.title: What a skill changes
svg.desc: Four steps a skill adds to how your agent works: do the work, check it for real, get a second opinion from a second AI, usually a different model, and wait for your yes before anything goes out. It ends with a receipt. The sample receipt says the status is blocked: prices saved locally, not published because the publish token is missing.
